svg.title: syntaqx home network
svg.desc: Floor-plan style map of the home network: GFiber 5 Gig into a GFiber 6E router and a TP-Link TL-SX1008 10G switch in the basement server room, wired drops to bedrooms and the family room, Wi-Fi devices in each room, and the darkrock and r630 servers.
